description: Implementation of the NetworkAnonymizationKey class, including methods for creation, serialization, and feature flag checks related to network privacy and partitioning.

classes.name: NetworkAnonymizationKey
classes.description: Represents a key used for network request privacy, supporting creation from sites and network isolation keys, serialization, and feature-based partitioning logic.

methods.name: NetworkAnonymizationKey
methods.description: Constructor initializing with site, cross-site flag, and optional nonce.

methods.name: CreateFromFrameSite
methods.description: Creates a key based on top frame site and frame site, determining cross-site status.

methods.name: CreateFromNetworkIsolationKey
methods.description: Creates a key from a NetworkIsolationKey, depending on its mode.

methods.name: CreateTransient
methods.description: Creates a transient (ephemeral) network anonymization key.

methods.name: ToDebugString
methods.description: Returns a human-readable string representing the key.

methods.name: IsPartitioningEnabled
methods.description: Checks if network partitioning is enabled based on feature flags.

methods.name: PartitionByDefault
methods.description: Sets the default partitioning behavior if no features override it.

methods.name: ClearGlobalsForTesting
methods.description: Resets global flags to default states for testing purposes.
